phase_policies.applies_when: Around 3 minutes, opponent posture unknown, ground-oriented army with Marines, heavy economy and expanding.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate when you see the opponent's first units or when you reach a new expansion.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Prioritize economy and tech; scout for opponent's tech choices; maintain defensive ground posture.
phase_policies.target: Establish a strong macro foundation: continue expanding and teching while maintaining a defensive posture. If enemy Reapers are seen, apply light harassment with your own Reapers while continuing macro.
phase_policies.title: Macro Foundation with Scouting
phase_policies.veto: Do not overcommit to harassment or expansion without scouting; avoid neglecting defensive positioning.

phase_policies.applies_when: Around 4-5 minutes, heavy economy and production, light air presence, opponent may show Siege Tanks and Marauders.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate when you see the opponent's first combat units or when you reach a new tech milestone.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Develop ground forces, scout for tech, transition to Siege Tanks if needed; maintain economy and production.
phase_policies.target: Continue developing ground army and economy, maintaining light harassment while scouting. If opponent shows Siege Tanks and Marauders, transition into a Siege Tank-based army to counter.
phase_policies.title: Ground Development with Siege Tank Transition
phase_policies.veto: Do not expand greedily without scouting; avoid neglecting anti-air if opponent techs to air.

phase_policies.applies_when: Around 8 minutes, moderate air presence and heavy ground armies, both players have similar units.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate when you see the opponent's tech choices or when you reach a new supply threshold.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Maintain balanced army, expand and tech, add air for support and scouting.
phase_policies.target: Strengthen ground army and increase air presence for medivac support. Continue expanding and teching to maintain advantage. Consider adding air units for scouting and drop potential.
phase_policies.title: Balanced Ground Army with Air Support
phase_policies.veto: Do not neglect upgrades or fall behind in army supply; avoid overcommitting to one unit composition.

phase_policies.applies_when: Around 10 minutes, opponent shows ground posture with Siege Tanks and Marauders, possibly with air units like Banshees and Ravens.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate when you see the opponent's tech choices or when you reach a new expansion.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Fortify defenses, expand, diversify tech to counter opponent's mix, ensure detection.
phase_policies.target: Strengthen defenses and continue expanding. If opponent mixes air and ground, diversify tech to counter, adding air defense and detection.
phase_policies.title: Defensive Strengthening with Tech Diversification
phase_policies.veto: Do not neglect anti-air defenses or detection; avoid overcommitting to a single tech path.

experiment_feedback.use_boundary: Prioritize execution risks only; never infer the strategic target from agent outcomes.
